You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0230.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
import numpy as np, math
rw=Chem.RWMol()
coords={}
# add atoms by label and element
els={
'A':'C','B':'C','C':'C','D':'C','E':'C','F':'C','G':'C','H':'C','V':'C','Q':'C','R':'C','S':'C','T':'C','U':'C','P':'C','X':'C','Y':'C','Z':'C','W':'C','K':'C','J':'C','I':'C',
'MA':'C','MC':'C','ME':'C','MG':'C','MS':'C','MY':'C','MW':'C',
'OH_H':'O','Or':'O','Oe':'O','Ocarbonyl':'O','OH_U':'O','OH_Z':'O'
}
xy={
'A':(212,106),'B':(316,45),'C':(420,106),'D':(523,45),'E':(627,106),'F':(627,226),'G':(771,307),'H':(771,455),
'V':(650,467),'Q':(627,583),'R':(731,645),'S':(731,766),'T':(627,822),'U':(523,766),'P':(523,645),
'X':(420,583),'Y':(316,646),'Z':(212,580),'W':(212,463),'K':(316,403),'J':(316,286),'I':(212,226),
'MA':(145,67),'MC':(420,180),'ME':(692,70),'MG':(831,274),'MS':(819,817),'MY':(316,734),'MW':(145,421),
'OH_H':(860,434),'Or':(807,574),'Oe':(420,466),'Ocarbonyl':(627,904),'OH_U':(457,800),'OH_Z':(137,620)
}
idx={}
for label,el in els.items():
 a=Chem.Atom(el); idx[label]=rw.AddAtom(a); coords[label]=xy[label]
def bond(a,b,order=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(idx[a],idx[b],order)
# chain and unsaturation
bond('A','B'); bond('B','C',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('C','D'); bond('C','MC'); bond('D','E'); bond('E','F'); bond('E','ME'); bond('F','G'); bond('G','MG'); bond('G','H');
# acetal/furan ring and central unsaturated ring
bond('H','OH_H'); bond('H','Or'); bond('H','V'); bond('V','Q',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
bond('Q','P'); bond('Q','R'); bond('R','Or'); bond('R','S',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('S','T'); bond('S','MS'); bond('T','Ocarbonyl',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('T','U'); bond('U','P',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('U','OH_U'); bond('P','X')
# left oxygenated six member ring and macrocyclic chain
bond('X','Oe'); bond('X','Y'); bond('Y','Z'); bond('Y','MY'); bond('Z','W'); bond('Z','OH_Z'); bond('W','K'); bond('W','MW'); bond('K','Oe'); bond('K','J'); bond('J','I'); bond('I','A'); bond('A','MA')
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
# Add coordinate template for a single center to translate wedge/hash depiction to RDKit chiral tags.
# Solid wedge has positive z (toward viewer); hashed wedge negative z.
wedges={
'A':{'MA':-1}, 'E':{'ME':+1}, 'G':{'MG':-1},
'H':{'OH_H':+1,'Or':+1}, 'Y':{'MY':-1}, 'Z':{'OH_Z':+1}, 'W':{'MW':+1}, 'K':{'Oe':+1}
}
# Conformer initialized all positions; reset local neighborhood before each stereocenter assignment.
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): conf.SetAtomPosition(i, Point3D(0,0,0))
m.AddConformer(conf, assignId=True)
conf=m.GetConformer()
for center, wedge_map in wedges.items():
 ci=idx[center]
 neigh=list(m.GetAtomWithIdx(ci).GetNeighbors())
 vecs={}
 for atom in neigh:
  j=atom.GetIdx()
  lab=next((k for k,v in idx.items() if v==j),None)
  if lab is None: # explicit H
   continue
  x1,y1=coords[center]; x2,y2=coords[lab]
  v=np.array([x2-x1, y1-y2, float(wedge_map.get(lab,0))*0.85],float)
  n=np.linalg.norm(v)
  v=v/n
  vecs[j]=v
 # Set known ligand vectors
 for j,v in vecs.items(): conf.SetAtomPosition(j,Point3D(*map(float,v)))
 # One explicit H is present for all these stereocenters except H, with H potentially not stereogenic? set it opposite others.
 hneigh=[a.GetIdx() for a in neigh if a.GetSymbol()=='H']
 if hneigh:
  # opposite vector sum of non-H neighbors; small perturbation if cancellation
  total=sum(vecs.values(), np.zeros(3))
  hvec=-total
  if np.linalg.norm(hvec)<1e-4: hvec=np.array([0.2,0.1,-1.])
  hvec=hvec/np.linalg.norm(hvec)
  conf.SetAtomPosition(hneigh[0],Point3D(*map(float,hvec)))
 conf.SetAtomPosition(ci,Point3D(0,0,0))
 # determine from this local 3D arrangement
 Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m, confId=0, replaceExistingTags=True)
 tag=m.GetAtomWithIdx(ci).GetChiralTag()
 print(center, tag, 'neighbors',[(next((k for k,v in idx.items() if v==a.GetIdx()),'H') , a.GetIdx()) for a in neigh])
# final stereochemistry + CIP
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, force=True, cleanIt=True)
for center in wedges:
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx[center]); print('CIP',center,a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?',a.GetChiralTag())
# Remove temporary conformer and embed
m.RemoveAllConformers()
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=230; params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True; params.useMacrocycle14config=True; params.maxIterations=2000
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed',res)
if res<0:
 params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=193; params.maxIterations=5000
 res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params); print('retry',res)
if res<0: raise RuntimeError('embedding failed')
# MMFF geometry minimization
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
if props:
 ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props); print('initial energy',ff.CalcEnergy()); ff.Minimize(maxIts=3000); print('final energy',ff.CalcEnergy())
else: AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=3000)
# ensure stereochem post conformer
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, force=True, cleanIt=True)
for center in wedges:
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx[center]); print('3dCIP',center,a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?')
# write explicit H all atoms
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\n3D structure generated from mol_0230.png\n')
 for atom in m.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx())
  f.write(f'{atom.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .6f} {p.y: .6f} {p.z: .6f}\n')
print('atoms',m.GetNumAtoms())
PY

cut=s.index("print('centers'")
s=s[:cut]+'''# Leave the unmarked stereocenter X unspecified, as the drawing has no wedge/dash there.
m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx['X']).SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,force=True,cleanIt=True)
print('specified stereochemistry',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m,includeUnassigned=True,includeCIP=True))
# Generate a 3D conformer and relax it with MMFF.
m.RemoveAllConformers()
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=230; params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True; params.useMacrocycle14config=True; params.maxIterations=3000
ret=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed status',ret)
if ret < 0:
    params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=903; params.maxIterations=5000
    ret=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
    print('retry status',ret)
if ret < 0: raise RuntimeError('3D embedding failed')
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props)
print('MMFF initial',ff.CalcEnergy())
ff.Minimize(maxIts=3000)
print('MMFF final',ff.CalcEnergy())
# Verify the assigned stereochemistry survived embedding and write XYZ, with explicit H atoms.
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,force=True,cleanIt=True)
print('3D stereocenters',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m,includeUnassigned=True,includeCIP=True))
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\\n3D structure generated from mol_0230.png\\n')
    for atom in m.GetAtoms():
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx())
        f.write(f'{atom.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .6f} {p.y: .6f} {p.z: .6f}\\n')
print('wrote answer.xyz',m.GetNumAtoms(),'atoms')
'''
open('make_answer.py','w').write(s)
